dod_intent_evidence: Completed a PFAS destruction demonstration for the DoD ESTCP program with DIU, USAF, and Navy (news, 2025-06-02), holds an AF SBIR PhII, and lists 'Military & Defense' as a named market on its own site.
score_evidence: '99% to 99.99% destruction and defluorination of PFAS' plus a homepage award wall (WEF, EPA challenge, GeekWire) → lab_language_intensity

'PLC based industrial control and automation... Operator and 24/7 system support... Deployable to most industrial sites... Operates using either temporary generator or grid power' → deployment fluency for industrial sites, which is why deployment_awareness_absence and operator_absence stay low
Single open role 'Director of Engineering' — an engineering-leadership hire, no field-service or government-compliance roles while DoD demos are converting → hiring_profile_skew held at 10

blind_spots.blind_spot: Treats the successful ESTCP demonstration as the finish line; no language anywhere about the acquisition path from demo to funded base remediation contracts
blind_spots.operator_reality: ESTCP demos that lack an advocacy chain and transition plan die in the gap between certification and procurement — the environmental office at a base cannot buy a Stampede unit off a demo report
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company is commercial-market led (semis, pharma, landfill); DoD is one of four markets and they appear to assume demo success self-converts
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Aquagga... has successfully completed a PFAS destruction demonstration for the Department of Defense (DoD) Environmental Security Technology Certification Program

blind_spots.blind_spot: Service model assumes reachable, connected, grid-adjacent sites
blind_spots.operator_reality: AFFF stockpiles and contaminated-site work sit on remote installations and fire training areas where 480V/3P power, 12,000 lb rigging, and a vendor's remote '24/7 system support' link are not givens; on-base networks also can't just host a vendor telemetry feed without accreditation
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: All deployment language is calibrated to industrial customers ('Deployable to most industrial sites'), not installations
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Operator and 24/7 system support ... Optional service for periodic automated sample collection

blind_spots.blind_spot: No CMMC/NIST 800-171 or prime flow-down language despite selling into DoD environmental remediation
blind_spots.operator_reality: DoD remediation work flows through environmental services primes with cyber and contract flow-downs; a hardware vendor without CMMC posture gets carved out of the teaming arrangement regardless of demo results
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their compliance vocabulary is environmental (EPA, ASME), not defense contracting
blind_spots.evidence_quote: System designed and manufactured in accordance with ASME codes

opener_hook: Aquagga's ESTCP demo with DIU, the Air Force, and Navy wrapped in June 2025 — the certification-to-procurement gap after an ESTCP success is where most PFAS-destruction fieldings on installations stall.
what_they_do: Builds hydrothermal alkaline treatment units that destroy PFAS in wastewater, sold to industrial, municipal, and defense remediation customers.
